COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPMS No.685 of 2024
Hon’ble Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.
Mr. Sandeep Kothari, learned counsel for 
the petitioner. 
2. Mr. K.S. Mehta, Addl. C.S.C. with Mr. 
Rajesh Pandey, learned Standing Counsel for 
the State. 
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submit 
that vide ex-parte order dated 29.09.2001 
application filed by the predecessor-in-interest 
of the petitioner under Section 229 of UPZA & 
LR Act was decided by the Assistant 
Commissioner; that, the revision preferred 
against this ex-parte order was dismissed on 
18.11.2011; that, against dismissal of revision, 
review was filed with delay condonation 
application and vide order dated 04.05.2012 the 
Board of Revenue accepted the review 
application for hearing and by impugned order 
dated 10.01.2024 the Board of Revenue 
disposed of the objections filed against the 
delay condonation application and fixed 
14.02.2024 for hearing on review application. 
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner would 
submit that the Board of Review, without 
passing any orders on the delay condonation 
application, has admitted the review 
application for hearing, which is bad in the 
eyes of law. 
5. Learned Standing Counsel would submit 
that the petitioner without challenging the 
initial order dated 10.01.2024 whereby the 
review application has been accepted for 
hearing, has challenged the subsequent order 
dated 14.02.2024.
6. Issue notices to respondent nos.3 to 10 
through ordinary process and registered post, 
acknowledgement due as well as by email and  WhatsApp, if available.
7. Steps to be taken within two weeks. 
8. Put up on 10.06.2024 for 
admission/orders.
9. Meanwhile, the petitioner is directed to 
file certified copies of the documents. 
(Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.) 
 18.03.2024
BS
